summary: Standards: finding 1 (brief/report answering USAGE) is fixed and I confirmed it in the binary for all 27 groups, with and without nosuch, but the guard is only atip_l0_31 (error-schema validity of brief --json and report nosuch --json); atip_l0_16 still tries only the bare tool and finding, so a regression of COMMAND_REQUIRED on brief/report would not fail it. Also status.rs:180 still documents meta.nextOmitted (it is data.nextOmitted).
